text:
## Process Overview  
**Account Opening Process:**
```
Customer Request
↓
Channel Selection (Branch/Online/Postal)
↓
Application Form Completion
↓
KYC Verification (ID + Address)
↓
AML Screening
↓
Risk Assessment
↓
Approval/Rejection Decision
↓
Account Creation (if approved)
↓
Card Issuance (if applicable)
↓
Customer Notification
↓
Account Activation
```  
**Timeline:** 1–2 business days (online/branch), 5–7 days (postal)

raw_entities.name: Account Opening Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for opening a new customer account, encompassing channel selection, application completion, KYC verification, AML screening, risk assessment, approval decision, account creation, card issuance, and customer notification. Timeline varies by channel: 1–2 business days for online/branch channels, 5–7 days for postal applications.

raw_entities.name: Customer Request Submission
raw_entities.description: Initial step where a customer initiates the account opening process by submitting a request.

raw_entities.name: Channel Selection
raw_entities.description: Customer selects the channel through which to proceed with account opening: Branch, Online, or Postal.

raw_entities.name: Application Form Completion
raw_entities.description: Customer completes the account opening application form with required personal and financial information.

raw_entities.name: KYC Verification
raw_entities.description: Verification of customer identity and address documentation as part of Know Your Customer compliance obligations.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening
raw_entities.description: Anti-Money Laundering screening performed to assess customer against sanctions and PEP lists.

raw_entities.name: Risk Assessment
raw_entities.description: Comprehensive risk assessment of the customer and application to determine suitability and compliance profile.

raw_entities.name: Approval or Rejection Decision
raw_entities.description: Final decision point where the application is either approved or rejected based on KYC, AML, and risk assessment outcomes.

raw_entities.name: Account Creation
raw_entities.description: System creation of the new account in the banking system, executed only if the application is approved.

raw_entities.name: Card Issuance
raw_entities.description: Issuance of a payment card associated with the new account, where applicable based on product type and customer eligibility.

raw_entities.name: Customer Notification
raw_entities.description: Communication to the customer regarding the outcome of their account opening application and next steps.

raw_entities.name: Account Activation
raw_entities.description: Final step enabling the customer to use the newly opened account for transactions and services.

raw_entities.name: Application Approval Gate
raw_entities.description: Decision point determining whether the account opening application is approved or rejected based on KYC, AML, and risk assessment results. Approved applications proceed to account creation; rejected applications terminate the process.

raw_entities.name: Identity and Address Verification
raw_entities.description: Know Your Customer verification process requiring collection and validation of customer identity and address documentation during account opening.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions and PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: Anti-Money Laundering screening process checking customer against sanctions lists and Politically Exposed Person registers as part of account opening compliance.

raw_entities.name: Account Opening Applicant
raw_entities.description: Individual customer applying to open a new account through the account opening process.

raw_entities.name: New Account
raw_entities.description: Account created upon approval of the account opening application, subject to successful completion of all verification and compliance steps.

raw_entities.name: Payment Card
raw_entities.description: Payment card issued to the customer in connection with the newly opened account, where applicable based on product and eligibility.
